adjudication.evidence: Original observations show two large, abrupt downward steps near index 415 (J1) and 468 (J3), with sustained offset in E and U (and weaker N) between them. P1 (415–469) aligns with the full temporary platform: onset at ~415 matches the step down, interior (420–462) shows stable offset (~−15 to −18 MAD in E/U), and return at ~468–469 matches the upward step. P2 (420–462) is a subset but excludes the clear onset and return edges; its tiny onset offsets (−0.37, −0.42, −0.63 MAD) are inconsistent with the observed ~15–18 MAD shift, indicating it misattributes the platform. Hypothesis P1 subtraction restores smooth motion across all axes; P2 does not fully remove the offset. No other independent temporary platforms exist in this interval.
